title: Maurice Durand
summary: Durand co-led a band with Humphrey, then played second trumpet for Perez, and played parades with him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Maurice Duran. Maurice Duran. Maurice Duran used to play with my, well, Maurice Duran used to have, him and Willie Humphries have a band together. Duran and Humphrey, when I was playing with Celestan and Rizley. Duran and Humphrey. Celestan and Rizley. Yeah. A lot of times we used to play with two bands. Yeah, Celestan and Humphrey. But after that, when I joined, when I joined, when I joined, uh, Ma'am Perez, Maurice Duran was playing with Ma'am Perez. Second trumpet. Yeah. He's not playing. He's not playing at all. No. His father, he was just a
time ago. His father died. I saw him in California. I know him. You met him? Yeah. Two years ago, I saw him. Yeah. He was a good trumpet player. Yeah.
He used to play with Ma'am Perez. I used to play at the Arab beef packing company parade with him every

corner of the day. Oh yeah? Because I used to play with him regularly too, you know. But he used to get that, Sam Johnson, you see that big parade, come up to the auditorium, I'll call it a day. Maurice Duran had that. Oh yeah. But he'd come up down there and everybody know him, you know. That was a long way, wasn't it? Oh yeah. We used to walk.
